prompt: An eight-second vertical advertisement in one continuous centred composition. Open on deep navy as softly defocused blue circuit paths breathe and drift into sharp focus. A glass phone-call icon assembles at centre inside an expanding ring of cyan light, a voicemail waveform rippling beneath it. The waveform breaks into mint and blue particles that stream into a small transparent processing core at centre. Inside, the particles settle into clean horizontal bars as a teal checkmark completes beside them. Keep the lower third calm and uncluttered throughout, and hold the centre of the frame open and low in contrast so type can be laid over it later. Everything drifts continuously and every change is a smooth defocus dissolve, never a cut.
